status: added before any round-2 simulation; the original file is unchanged
reasons: PI 2026-11-18: compare designs at the same height; add a loosened condition; report wording
layer-B audit D-20261118-45 / -41: cross-arm order for the novelty rule; a metric for B vs A

heights.rule: every design of every arm is simulated at both heights (base meshes cage_A_*_d1.000 / d0.500); the height is not a free choice of any arm

verdict: the final class is read at the REFERENCE height with the verdict chain in force when the round is read out
added_metrics: holds-when-loosened: at the loosened height both friction windows are usable and the posterior translation in extension is below 0.45 mm (the archive families reach 0.43-0.55 mm there)
loosened fixation values: posterior translation in extension and mu_req at the loosened height (lower is better), reported per design
primary_metric: unchanged for B vs R: passing-novel designs per design proposed; holds-when-loosened designs per design proposed is reported next to it as the test of fixation by shape

b_vs_a.note: arm A designs can never be new by the distance rule (they stay inside the archive families), so the primary metric does not apply to A
b_vs_a.metric: designs that PASS at the reference height AND hold when loosened, per GPU-hour

novelty_order: within a round the designs are ordered R-01..R-05, then B-01..B-05, then the audit-lane design; a design is compared with the archive and with every earlier design in this order; arm A designs, twins and replicates are not part of the order

budgets.B: <= 5 designs x 2 heights + 5 ablation twins (tied screening at the loosened height only)
budgets.change: B, R and the audit lane run twice as many friction cases as planned before (two heights): about 11 more cases per round

card_readout: mu_req from tied screening at the LOOSENED height, design vs twin (replaces "tied screening" without a height)

compiler_rules.S4: void region touching both endplates >= 50 % of the disc-space volume and meeting each endplate over >= 25 % of the footprint (25 % provisional)
compiler_rules.S5_overhang: support from the element underneath or a side neighbour (45 degrees)
compiler_rules.note: valid = passes these checks as implemented on the day the design is compiled; the compiler version (git hash) is recorded with each design
